name: Retro Anime and Comic style - Vibrant Colors
description: Trained on a collection of my own images. Which are made from a mix of about 6 Loras. It gives me just the kind of look I was looking for. My friend suggested me to upload it saying it would most likely be popular. Some 80s style anime, dark fantasy and western comic look. Basically the animation I grew up with and love. With a focus on intense and vibrant coloring.
